رققت (form I)
# رَقَقْتُ (raqaqtu) /ra.qaq.tu/: first-person singular past active of رَقَّ (raqqa)
# رَقَقْتَ (raqaqta) /ra.qaq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of رَقَّ (raqqa)
# رَقَقْتِ (raqaqti) /ra.qaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of رَقَّ (raqqa)
# رُقِقْتُ (ruqiqtu) /ru.qiq.tu/: first-person singular past passive of رَقَّ (raqqa)
# رُقِقْتَ (ruqiqta) /ru
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
